summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (JTM 2.12/2)

data.turoyo: <...> qulfiwo i qarʕo ʕawwəl naqqa, mqaṭʕiwola hawxa falqe, <...>
data.translation: <...> Zuerst schälte man den Kürbis, dann schnitt man ihn in Stücke <...>

rationale: First active Infectum-wa: generic agents peel an overt pumpkin before cutting it.

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (JTM 2.3/4)

data.turoyo: <...> hanək ste qulfinawull, mqaṭʕinawulle, qulfinawo u lebaṯṯe ste hawxa d lowe ... <...>
data.translation: <...> Die Kürbisse schälten wir, schnitten sie in Stücke, entfernten das Innere, damit es nicht .... <...>

rationale: New active Infectum-wa: 1pl and contracted object suffix; the same quotation includes the second interior-removal token.

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (JTM 2.3/5)

data.turoyo: <...> Annaqqa bəṯr qulfinawulle, mqalenawulle ste čike, a hno, aq qarʕe.
data.translation: <...> Nun, nachdem wir sie geschält hatten, brieten wir sie, die Kürbisse, ein wenig an.

rationale: New active Infectum-wa with full -lle ending; German anteriority does not determine the box.

summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (Jan 1.16/755)

data.turoyo: W kul zlam d əzzewo lu Ṭuro kluzamwole šalfo. Ənkan d quṭaʕle mede, ənkan doxəl mede, qulafle fekiye mede dowe.
data.translation: And every man who went to the mountains needed a knife. Whether to cut something, whether he ate something, he would peel some fruit or something.

rationale: First active Preterit quotation, provisionally refiled by -le agent morphology parallel to quṭaʕle; a conditional habitual setting does not determine the box. Translation is project machine translation.

data.turoyo: Kito u garso ste. Hawo, dlo šloqo kosaymile. Komatrən aḥ ḥeṭe, hanək ste, kodayqənne, hul d məqlofo i kalpkaṯṯe.
data.translation: Es gibt auch gärso. Der wird ohne Kochen bereitet. Man feuchtet den Weizen an und schlägt ihn, bis sich die Kleie davon löst.

rationale: Thin Detransitive Infectum: bran separates as endpoint of moistening and pounding.

data.turoyo: Ḥasane Aliki qayəm, azzele l u=ḥəmmam, fayəš traḥṣar=yawme, traḥṣar lalye b u=ḥəmmam, hawi həmamiš, qlifo i=kačliyayḏe kule, hawi qarʕe, xd u=baṣlo.
data.translation: Er ging ins Bad, blieb dort zwölf Tage und zwölf Nächte, bis er blitz sauber geworden war, und der Grind sich abgeschält hatte. Sein Kopf wurde blank wie eine Zwiebel.

rationale: Thin Detransitive Preterit: feminine scab subject and complete shedding after bathing.

summary: The active paradigm and gloss already exist; the examples add active Infectum-wa, not a new stem or Detransitive paradigm.
Human agents peel zero-marked pumpkins or suffixal patients. Detransitive clauses instead have scabs, husks or bran as subjects, without an expressed external agent.
Detransitive separation can follow pounding or bathing without becoming active syntax. Two qlif tokens at 30/23 are already covered by one inherited example.
qulfinawull and qulfinawulle retain their printed endings. bəṯr marks a prior habitual step with Infectum-wa. No new fixed idiom is established.
Round 1 establishes active Infectum-wa, alongside inherited Detransitive skin/husk separation. This Jan occurrence is active knife use, not Detransitive.

qulafle is provisionally Preterit, with l-agent suffix parallel to adjacent quṭaʕle. The indefinite fekiye mede does not securely identify -le as an object clitic, and the supplied would translation does not settle morphology.
Printed qulafle is preserved without normalizing its vowels to the inherited qləfle. This is a qualified filing proposal, not a claim to an independently established dialectal paradigm.
Jan English is project machine translation, copied verbatim in the quotation; the literal fruit/knife co-text supports peeling without relying on it.
Does qulfinawo u lebaṯṯe specifically mean hollow/scoop out the pumpkins, or broader peeling/removal?
Confirm contracted final -ll versus -lle; preserve the edition's forms.
Confirm qulafle at Jan 1.16/755: Preterit with l-agent versus Infectum qoləf plus -le object. Its provisional Preterit filing follows adjacent quṭaʕle; no unequivocal new Infectum cell is claimed.
u lebaṯṯe expresses the removed interior in a peeling sequence; scooping out as a distinct operation remains uncertain.
Fruit as theme in a knife-use description supports active peeling already attested for pumpkins in round 1; no new sense or idiom.
